data.body_html:
Planning a marbella boat charter stag weekend itinerary 2026 doesn't have to be complicated. This guide covers the best boats, real prices, and a no-fluff route to make your stag do unforgettable – without the sales pitch. Whether you want a two-hour party cruise or a full-day island hop, we've got the numbers you need.

Why Choose a Boat Charter for a Stag Weekend in Marbella?

Marbella's Costa del Sol offers 320 days of sunshine a year, with sea temperatures hitting 28–32°C from June to September. A private boat charter from Puerto Banús gives your group exclusive access to secluded coves, beach clubs, and a floating party platform. No queues, no crowds – just your crew, a skipper, and unlimited cava.

Our Fleet: Best Boats for Stag Groups

We operate 16 boats from Puerto Banús, ranging from 6.4m speedboats to 29m superyachts. For stags, these are the top picks:

  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. Perfect for a budget-friendly party.
  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – Same Tier A pricing, spacious flybridge.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719 minimum 4 hours, includes a free jet ski.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – Pricing on request, great for larger groups.
  • Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) – Sporty and fast, ideal for a shorter adrenaline hit.

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVAT. No hidden costs.

Sample Stag Weekend Itinerary 2026

Here's a realistic 2-day itinerary based on our most popular bookings:

Day 1: Arrival & Evening Party Cruise

  • 18:00 – Board your Azimut 39 at Puerto Banús. Welcome cava and beer.
  • 18:30–20:30 – 2-hour cruise along the Golden Mile, past La Concha mountain views. Stop for a swim at Cala del Faro.
  • 20:30 – Return to port. Head to Ocean Club or Pangea for dinner and nightlife.

Day 2: Full-Day Boat Adventure

  • 10:00 – Board the Mangusta 80. Skipper briefs the route: Cabopino or Estepona.
  • 10:30–14:00 – Cruise south, jet ski relay, anchor at Cala Cortés for swimming.
  • 14:00–15:30 – Lunch on board (bring your own or order from a beach club).
  • 15:30–17:30 – Return leg with music, drinks, and sunset photos.
  • 17:30 – Back at Puerto Banús. Optional: book a table at La Sala.

All prices include Spanish VAT (21%). No tipping required, but appreciated.

Best Stops and Routes from Puerto Banús

  • Cabopino – 20 minutes east. Sandy beach with chiringuitos (beach bars).
  • Estepona – 30 minutes west. Quieter waters, great for jet skiing.
  • Cala del Faro – 15 minutes south. Rocky cove with clear water, ideal for cliff jumping.
  • Río Verde – 10 minutes. Exclusive beach club area, often less crowded.
  • Sotogrande – 45 minutes. Luxury marina, but best for full-day charters.

Your skipper will adjust based on weather and group preferences.

Booking Tips for 2026 Stag Weekends

  • Book 4–6 weeks ahead for June–September weekends. Tier A boats often sell out.
  • Confirm group size early – most boats max at 12 pax. For 13+, consider two boats.
  • Deposit (usually 50%) secures your slot. Balance due on the day.
  • Bring sunscreen, towels, and a waterproof speaker if you want extra bass.
  • Check the weather – Mediterranean is calm 90% of summer, but May and October can have wind.
